desc: The Trijicon Tenmile is a first focal plane riflescope that lets you dial-in long-range shots in any environment or light with confidence. Expect pinpoint precision at multiple ranges, all-weather performance and outstanding quality and design for repeatable precision. The MRAD Precision Tree reticle offers precise wind and range holds and the exposed zero stop elevation adjuster allows you to quickly return to zero. Includes Sunshade, Tenebraex Flip Caps, Scopecoat, 3mm and 1.5mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide, and logo sticker.
